court: In the High Court of Madras
advocates: For Petitioner(s): Mr. S. Kumara Devan
prayer: Prayer:- This Civil Revision Petition has been filed under Article 227 of the Constitution of India seeking to call for the records relating to IA No. 7 of 2024 in OS No. 164 of 2015 dated 30-8-2024 on the file of the The learned principal District Munsif, 1st Additional District Munsif (FAC) Virudhachalam, and quash the same.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

Abdul Quddhose, J.:— This Civil Revision Petition has been filed challenging the impugned order dated 30-8-2024 passed by the learned principal District Munsif, I Additional District Munsif (FAC), Vridhachalam, in I.A. No. 7 of 2024 in O.S. No. 164 of 2015.

2. The learned counsel for the petitioner on instructions would now submit that eventhough the petitioner has challenged the impugned order as stated supra, it would suffice if a direction is issued to the trial court to dispose of the suit in O.S. No. 164 of 2015 within a time frame to be fixed by this Court.

3. This Court is not interfering with the impugned order. But, no prejudice will be caused to any of the parties if a direction is issued to the trial court to dispose of the suit within a time frame to be fixed by this court. The suit is of the year 2015. Therefore, this Court directs the trial court, namely, principal District Munsif, I Additional District Munsif (FAC), Vridhachalam, to dispose of the suit in O.S. No. 164 of 2015 within a period of one year from the date of receipt of a copy of this order. With this direction, this Civil Revision Petition is disposed of. No Costs. C.M.P. No. 8144 of 2026 is closed.
